root_text:
Recent reports show that Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) infections in China are at normal levels, with 6% of respiratory samples testing positive.

Symptoms resemble flu and cold, but WHO confirms no cause for alarm.

 1/2 https://t.co/VFEPZ8
